name: overnight
description: Example overnight session — code audit + creative + research

jobs.name: Lua Code Audit
jobs.prompt:
Review this Roblox Lua code for bugs, performance issues, and best practices. Focus on: null safety, table manipulation, RemoteEvent security, and memory leaks.

Provide specific, actionable feedback with line references.
jobs.system_prompt: You are an expert Roblox Luau code reviewer. Be thorough but concise.

jobs.name: Harbor Vignettes
jobs.prompt: Write a 500-word vignette about life in a fishing village called Slackwater. Focus on sensory details: salt, rope, lantern light, the sound of hulls creaking. Include at least one memorable character.
jobs.system_prompt: You are a skilled creative writer with a gift for maritime atmosphere and human detail.

jobs.name: Luau Performance Research
jobs.prompt: Research Roblox Luau performance optimization patterns. Cover: table.create vs literal tables, spatial queries, Instance:FindFirstChild alternatives, garbage collection tuning, and actor model parallelism.
jobs.system_prompt: You are a research analyst specializing in game engine performance. Be objective and cite specifics.
